table.name: TLGNC_SHIPTO_BILLTO
table.description: The SOLDTO-billto relations are defined by SAP's partner functions, received via the SAP BP import interface and stored in tlgns_sap_bp_pf_billto. This table is a subselection of those relations but defined per SHIPTO (of that soldto) and Sales Area.

column.name: SHIPTO_BILLTO_ID
column.description: PK. Entries in this table are a subselection of all possible SOLDTO-billto relations (from SAP), defined per shipto/sales area of that soldto.

column.name: SHIPTO_SAREA_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shipto_sarea. The Shipto-Sales Area-tuple for which the billto is set.

column.name: BILLTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. The billto. This table stores all possible billto on a Dispokarte (shipto-salesarea); the actual billto for an order is set a) by a default billto b) by the Billto-Rhythm or c) overridden by the user.
